name: Amisulpride
metabolism: Metabolism is limited. Much of the absorbed drug is eliminated unchanged by the kidneys; oxidative CYP metabolism is not its principal elimination route.
summary: Amisulpride is an atypical antipsychotic used to treat schizophrenia and psychotic episodes; it is also used for depression and postoperative nausea and vomiting in some settings. It blocks dopamine D2 receptors and can raise prolactin levels.
